instruction: The precondition file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file and use the existing XZ-plane rounded-slot sketch as the larger first loft profile. Create a second sketch on a plane parallel to the XY plane with an attachment offset of Z = -30 mm. In the second sketch, draw the same rounded-slot shape at half scale, centered 30 mm from the origin in the positive Y direction. Create a Part Design Additive Loft between the two rounded-slot profiles so the final solid is a flared, horn-like rounded-slot loft that widens from the smaller offset profile to the larger original profile. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
